verse.verse_1: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the Companions of the Elephant?
verse.verse_2: Did He not make their treacherous plan go astray?
verse.verse_3: And He sent against them Flights of Birds,
verse.verse_4: Striking them with stones of baked clay.
verse.verse_5: Then did He make them like an empty field of stalks and straw, (of which the corn) has been eaten up.
